verdict.rationale: Corporations Canada is a government corporate registry and filing service (incorporation, annual returns, amendments). User-defined scheduling of recurring jobs or workflows is a general automation-platform capability outside this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships such a feature: annual returns are filed manually online, and the email notices are one-off change notifications, not a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
